No. 2433/08 - MONDAY, APRIL 21, 2025
EXTRAORDINARY
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Notice Under Section 7
My No.: DS/MN/LB/05/AQ/WPP/PhI./Ext/16.
Land Ministry No. : 4-3/11/2022/CEB/150.

I hereby give notice, under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, as amended by the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964 that the Government intends to acquire the following land/servitude which is required for a public purpose.

Description of the land or servitude to be acquired : The land allotments called Olaithoduvaikani, in total extent of about 2.9343 Hectares depicted as Lot No. 1 in Block No. 03, Sheet No. 08 of Plan No. Cadastral 940060, and prepared by the Surveyor General, situated in the Village called Olaithoduvai in the Grama Niladhari Division No. 60 of Olaithoduvai, in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Mannar Town of Mannar District in Northern Province :
Plan No. Cadastral - 940060, Block No. 03, Sheet No. 08
01. Lot No. 01 Name of the Land: Olaithoduvaikani; Description : Garden, contains 18 Palmyra Trees (10-15 Years); Claimant: State; Original Claimant: Not Known; Extent: 2.9343 Hectares.
This Gazette Extraordinary can be downloaded from www.documents.gov.lk
(Published by Authority)
PART III — LANDS
Land Acquisition Notices

The dates and the time of the inquiries : All persons interested in the aforesaid land on which servitude is to be acquired are hereby required to appear personally, or by agents duly authorized in writing, before me at 10.00 a.m. on the 04th day of June 2025 at Divisional Secretariat Mannar Town.

And further, you are hereby requested to notify me in writing (in duplicate) on or before the 28th day of May 2025, the nature of their interest in the land, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said land/servitude, the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount.
M. Piratheep, Divisional Secretary, Mannar Town. At the Divisional Secretariat, Mannar Town, 11th April, 2025. EOG 04 - 0151/1
